scope: Static source comparison, planning only; no repository code executed, no integration performed

groups.description_and_evidence: **Transport extracted behind C ABI 3**: `src/transport/TransportApi.h:8`, Provider.cpp, SteamBackend.cpp, UdpBackend.cpp; GAME_RELIABLE/GAME_STATE/SAVE_BULK traffic classes, retained backpressure, event generations. `src/plugin/net/NativeFrame.h`, NativeValues.h and NetLink.cpp consume this framing. Dependencies pin GNS 1.6.1 `d534c19a` and protobuf 21.12 `f0dc78d7` in src/transport/dependencies.json.
savas_overlap_and_integration: Absent from Savas, which retains ENet/Steam tunnel NetLink.

Late backend migration, not a wholesale NetLink merge over Savas. Define a Transport interface and shared DTO codec; retain ENet for regression comparison. Do not transfer STL/CRT ownership across the modern-provider/v100 boundary.

groups.description_and_evidence: **Modular native UI API 4**: src/ui/CoopUiApi.h:5, CoopUi.cpp, src/plugin/core/UiModule.cpp; POD snapshots/commands. UI callbacks enqueue commands; core executes them on the game thread. Localized fields, lifecycle status/diagnostics and a redacting exporter in UiPrivacy.h.
savas_overlap_and_integration: Savas has its own engine MyGUI multiplayer lobby, not this UI.
Adapt the view to a shared Session API. Avoid competing panels and independent connection flows.

groups.description_and_evidence: **Four-component updater**: src/plugin/net/Updater.cpp:234 fetches a manifest; UpdatePackage.* parses/installs/recovers packages with verified hashes, version ordering and rollback marker. RuntimeImages.h blocks runtime loads during replacement.
savas_overlap_and_integration: Absent from Savas.
Separate packaging task after backend stabilization. Replace donor feed owner/repository and align all binary ABIs.

groups.description_and_evidence: **N-player membership/roster/incarnations**: Wire.h MAX_PLAYERS=4/MAX_JOINS=3, PKT_PLAYER_ROSTER=49, SESSION_ACK=51; NetLink.cpp, NativeFrame.h, OwnRanks.h:51. Peer-slot reuse and relay origin are bound to the current incarnation.
savas_overlap_and_integration: Partial overlap: Savas already has N-player topology, owner validation and persistent Steam squad ownership, with a different contract.
Keep one Savas-derived registry. Extract membership fences, peer-retirement invariants and tests; separate PlayerId/campaign identity from connection incarnation.

groups.description_and_evidence: **World/load readiness barrier**: PKT_WORLD_READY=50, LoadGo.worldToken, TimePacket.readyLoadId; Plugin.cpp:267/1974 and SaveXfer.cpp. After native load, wait for procedural reconciliation/READY rather than just successful save download.
savas_overlap_and_integration: Savas has bootstrap/save/load handling but not this worldToken/procedural-ready contract.
Port a central state machine before new world channels, shared by every transport. Correctness must not depend on whether user-facing time/speed sync is enabled.

groups.description_and_evidence: **Complete staged inventory snapshots**: Wire.h:609 uses u16 count, revision/offset/totalCount/digest, 64 rows/frame, 4096 total, u16 parentIdx and grid section/x/y. core/InventorySnapshotAssembler.h:58 and InventorySnapshotRevision.h; Inbound.h assembles a complete snapshot before handing it to the replicator.
savas_overlap_and_integration: Absent from Savas, which retains the original snapshot shape/limits.
Port codec, assembler and engine application together, including bounds, parent matching and handshake/schema. Raising only the count requires a downstream stack/buffer audit.

groups.description_and_evidence: **Host-authoritative native shop/extraction transactions**: game/InventoryTransactionBridge.h and InventoryTransactionRules.h; ReplicatorItems.cpp:1906 builds NativeShopIntent. Host commitNativeShopTransaction checks sourceRevision/actorRevision, replay conflicts, quote ceiling/floor and checkpoint/ACK.
savas_overlap_and_integration: Alternative to Savas65 merchant-window lock and absolute touched-line handover (TradeHeader, sendTradeOp/tickTrade).

Select one transaction coordinator. Two sets of native hooks/handlers could count the same item/debit twice. Define transaction ID, item identity, payer policy and outcome journal before extracting tests/pure policies.

groups.description_and_evidence: **Inventory/cursor lifetime and conservation**: EngineInventory.cpp, EngineInternal.cpp, ReplicatorItems.cpp. InventorySnapshotRevision::accept applies committed state once to an owned pocket; checkpoint equivalence compares quantities/parents while ignoring incidental grid packing.
savas_overlap_and_integration: Partial overlap: Savas has inventory transfer/save/native-item fixes but not these staged checkpoint policies.
Port individual invariants with a reproduction on Savas instead of replacing an entire file with more than 2500 changed lines.

groups.description_and_evidence: **Host-versioned locks/doors**: sync/LockAuthority.h:6, ReplicatorChannels.cpp:923 publishDoors/applyDoors. Peer requests do not advance the durable clock; DoorPacket has parentHand/doorIndex. Authoritative lock survives convergence/unload.
savas_overlap_and_integration: Savas has door/lock sync without this authority/revision layer.

Extract pure admission policy and an adapter. Requires shared fixture identity, including Ximery-related identity fixes. Test both players lockpicking, stale replay/rejoin and parentless placed doors.

groups.description_and_evidence: **Carried-body drop/landing pose and bed retention**: EventPacket poseValid/x/y/z/heading, DROP_ARG_LANDING; ReplicatorDrive.cpp:213, EngineSpawnCombat.cpp, EngineInternal.cpp, applyFurniture. Missing fixtures allow guarded materialization only for an accepted actor.
savas_overlap_and_integration: Savas58.1 also fixes carry/bed/NPC behavior, using different code and wire.
Deduplicate using concrete reproductions. Fixture materialization requires proven provenance/conservation.

groups.description_and_evidence: **Procedural camp-bed regions**: EngineProcedural.cpp, ProceduralWorldSync.cpp, core/ProceduralWorldState.h; BEGIN/ROW/END/ACK/RETIRE/SCOPE_COMMIT, world/load/region/epoch/digest, quantized descriptors and complete-native-census fence. Wired into Plugin, strictly limited to PROC_CATEGORY_CAMP_BED.
savas_overlap_and_integration: Absent from Savas.
Later optional world channel. Readiness depends on K05 and canonical fixture IDs. This is not universal synchronization of procedural objects.

groups.description_and_evidence: **EnvironmentItemsSync is experimental and disabled in public Release**: Plugin.cpp:76 returns false outside HARNESS; Harness also requires KENSHICOOP_ENVIRONMENT_ITEMS=1. Implemented by EnvironmentItemsSync.cpp, EngineEnvironmentItems.cpp, EnvironmentItemsState/EnvironmentItemPacket.
savas_overlap_and_integration: Absent from Savas.
Preserve behind an experimental flag with tests; code presence does not justify public enablement.

groups.description_and_evidence: **Alternative money/speed policies**: ReplicatorChannels.cpp:712/808 broadcasts Money.ackSeq=0; guests adopt total and pending reapply is removed. SpeedAdmission.h accepts SPEED_COMMAND, using the latest host-sequenced real action rather than heartbeat votes; combat cap was removed.
savas_overlap_and_integration: Conflicts with Savas shared-pool per-owner ACK/pending reconciliation and speed consensus.
Keep strict Savas per-owner ACK for shared money. Make speed arbitration an explicit campaign policy with one active handler.

groups.description_and_evidence: **Public Steam server browser**: net/SteamInvite.cpp:350 refreshServerRow/onLobbyMatchList; optional RequestLobbyList/GetLobbyByIndex/AddRequestLobbyListStringFilter, kc_game=KenshiCoop filter, name/players/password/compatibility, up to 16 rows. browseServers/joinServer/hostPublicServer create a two-player public lobby.
savas_overlap_and_integration: Savas has friend lobbies/invites but lacks these browser functions/metadata. Port discovery to its Session API, replace the hard-coded two-player limit and filter schema/version/capabilities.

groups.description_and_evidence: **F10 MULTIPLAYER panel and persistent LAN settings**: game/MultiplayerUi.cpp (789 lines), MultiplayerUi.h and Plugin wiring; core/Config.cpp stores serverName/password/LAN values. Original F2 remains.
savas_overlap_and_integration: Alternative UI to Savas/Kotets. Move browser/password controls into the selected UI, not a second independent connection owner.

groups.description_and_evidence: **Handshake refusal and password gate**: Wire.h protocol 57, Hello.pwHash, PKT_AUTH_FAIL=250, AuthFailPacket.reason/peerVersion. passwordHash64 is unsalted FNV-1a64, not cryptographic authentication. NetLink.cpp sends reliable refusal, flush/disconnect_later; authFailed latches stop reconnect and CONNECT clears the latch.
savas_overlap_and_integration: Refusal reasons/latches are useful separately from password design. Do not reuse FNV as public-server protection: the hash is replayable bearer-equivalent data. Define authentication through a reviewed challenge/nonce or authenticated transport identity, and use one error model for password/version failures.

groups.description_and_evidence: **Persistent anonymous slots 0–8**: netproto/SessionSlots.h::assign/restore supports eight guest bindings; Hello.clientTokenLo/Hi and Welcome.privateWorld*. core/Config.cpp:110 uses coop_user.dat, NetLink.cpp:698/758; sync/PlayerSlotSession.h stores checksummed KCOOP_PLAYERS_1 coop_players.dat. Offline players retain slots.
savas_overlap_and_integration: Alternative to Savas SteamId-to-rank mapping. Define one logical PlayerIdentity with transport-specific Steam/token identities and explicit reassignment/import. A new guest must not silently inherit another player’s wallet/reputation. The token is not strong authentication.

groups.description_and_evidence: **Private squad ownership, UI enforcement and recruit routing**: PrivateSquadSession::capture/restoreForSlot stores checksummed KCSQ002 coop_squads.dat with durable per-body ownerSlot. PrivateSquadUi.h filters tabs/management and peer inspection does not add selectedCharacters. PrivateRecruit.h, ReplicatorSpawn.cpp and EngineWorld.cpp route recruits/rekeys. GuestRosterPlan/Session create missing logical guest bodies on host, bound retries and wait for durable pinning.
savas_overlap_and_integration: Savas already persists squad assignment using its registry and shared native faction. Port ownership policy/validation without duplicating body pins. Private-tab presentation and inspect restrictions are optional policies.

groups.description_and_evidence: **Separate wallets with a durable checkpoint**: SeparateWallet/SeparateWalletSession::{tick,setBalance,vendorBegin,vendorFinish,readyForSave}; per-slot balance, epoch/exact-next sequence, reconnect replay and pending ACK. A new guest has native wallet zero until snapshot. coop_wallets.dat joins the coordinated save; temp-file, FlushFileBuffers and MoveFileEx commit. Plugin.privateWalletMode disables shared-money sampling.
savas_overlap_and_integration: Direct conflict with Savas/Kotets/nhoral shared money. Select EconomyPolicy shared/private before campaign creation and persist it in a manifest. Migration needs an explicit allocation rule. Native vendor debits must call one Economy service.

groups.description_and_evidence: **Personal faction relations/crime consequences**: PrivateFactionNative hooks and PrivateFactionLedger/Session/Snapshot, netproto/PrivateFactionWire.h and pending causes. Owner/direction/sequence, world nonce/load fence/READY, host-authoritative legal cause→owner row/ACK, coop_factions.dat. Plugin.cpp:2665 enables this by default for private squads outside scenarios.
savas_overlap_and_integration: Savas has shared faction/bounty corrections but no personal relationship history. Large optional gameplay policy requiring authoritative event ownership and persistence migration. Two faction-hook paths would apply consequences twice.

groups.description_and_evidence: **Vendor64/65/66 atomic trade coordinator**: VendorCoordinator64/Ledger64/Types64/Protocol64; lease/grant/state/ack/release/busy, complete chunked stock plus cash, walletBefore/After/seq and actor inventoryHash/world/generation/revision. EngineVendor64.inl::installVendorHooks64 hooks ShopTrader ctor/dtor, RClickAutoTrade, mouse pickup/placement and ActivePlatoon::refreshInventory. Restock schedule66 and exact native-inventory ACK complete the checkpoint; coop_vendors.dat. Plugin.cpp:2148 requires native hooks and separateMoney.
savas_overlap_and_integration: Competes with Savas65 touched-line handover and Kotets host-native transactions: three implementations of one responsibility.

Define one merchant/stock identity, transaction journal and Economy API. Adapt complete-stock/wallet atomicity/restock invariants and separately establish pricing/authorship; do not activate all three coordinators.

groups.description_and_evidence: **Item charges, uniqueness, theft ownership and exact inventory convergence**: InvItemEntry adds chargesRemaining/nativeUnique/properOwner[5]. ItemCharges.h, EngineInventory.cpp:534::reconcileChargedItems, planItemCharges, sameInventoryMetadata64, captureContainerDigest64. Reuse/equip native items first, free grid space, then create additions. Failure removes only newly created items and rolls back moves/quantity/charges. The .5.3.1 fix is present in source.
savas_overlap_and_integration: Savas lacks these wire fields/charge reconciliation. Port item identity/hash/equality consistently across snapshots, transfers, vendors, saves and tests. Coordinate with Kotets 4096-item/grid/parent support; do not copy fixed 64-entry scratch arrays without auditing limits.

groups.description_and_evidence: **Signed medical levels**: MedicalWire.h and TreatmentPacket.partMask/partBand[]. Engine treatment applies a mask instead of treating -1 as a “do not apply” sentinel.
savas_overlap_and_integration: Savas65 lacks this structure. A narrow port requiring a wire change; test legitimate negative levels, mask bounds, partial limbs, NaN and repeated treatment.

groups.description_and_evidence: **Host relay policy, chat and display names**: PacketRoute.h hostOnly/guestRequestOnly/senderMatches/validRelay, strict length/bounds/medical validation; ChatPacket=49, PlayerName=50 and ChatText.h. NetLink rejects forged ownerId and must not blindly forward authority messages. Names are independent of Steam.
savas_overlap_and_integration: Savas has its own N-player relay/authorship model. Reuse the policy boundary as a specification and negative-test source; keep one registry/owner lookup rather than adding a second routing table with an old enum.

groups.description_and_evidence: **Last-action speed intent**: SharedSpeed.h::receive accepts SPEED_USER_INTENT; telemetry cannot overwrite the last real action. Optional combat cap through effective(combat,cap).
savas_overlap_and_integration: Alternative to Savas minimum-vote consensus. Select one SpeedPolicy with consistent user-intent/heartbeat serialization. Do not run minimum-vote and last-action handlers together.

groups.description_and_evidence: **Coordinated persistence fences**: Plugin before-save guard freezes player/squad/wallet/faction/vendor snapshots. SaveXfer.cpp transfers sidecars with the native world/fingerprint and avoids publishing an inconsistent checkpoint. Unacknowledged vendor/faction/money operations block saving.
savas_overlap_and_integration: Savas has save-safety fixes but not this sidecar/domain-atomic capture. Define PrepareSave/Capture/Commit with an all-or-nothing manifest. A .dat file alone is insufficient without lifecycle hooks, rollback and fingerprint coverage.

groups.description_and_evidence: **Canonical identity/protocol-next foundation is not live**: CanonicalWire.h:1, CanonicalControl.h, CanonicalRekey.h, RuntimeIdentity*.h and CanonicalTransport.h:1 explicitly state “Not installed in NetLink”; live NetLink does not use the Adapter.
savas_overlap_and_integration: Do not treat this as a completed fix for all Provod runtime-handle bugs. Preserve as a design/test prototype. A unified ID layer still needs integration, snapshot/rekey rules, world/stream epochs and evidence beyond adding headers.

Kotets environment sync disabled in public Release and opt-in Harness only
Provod canonical identity transport is prototype not installed in live NetLink
Provod protocol66 is its own schema; no compatibility implied by number
Three competing commerce implementations require one unified transaction authority
Provod separate wallet/faction modes conflict with shared native faction/pool policies
LRaverdy independent engine1.0.68+C++20 architecture; lineage and transfer license not established; root LICENSE absent
